contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is entirely blank at 90 dpi and at 170 dpi normalized — an EMPTY SCHEDULE, zero rows. Cover line 1 reads 0 / 0 / 0 across LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE, so the empty schedule agrees with the printed anchor. The Carr form prints NO schedule total on p2 (it ends with the 'If additional space is needed' note), so schedule_total is null by form design and the cover line is the only anchor. THIS and CUMULATIVE coincide (first/only report of the cycle on this cover).

expenditures.detail: One inked row on Form B (p3) reading 129.00 equals BOTH cover line 3 THIS (129.00) and CUMULATIVE (129.00); LAST is 0, so the two scopes coincide on this first/only report. Carr Form B prints no schedule total, so schedule_total is null by form design.

gates.page_subtotal: No printed schedule or page subtotal exists on the Carr Form A/Form B sheets (form design). Gate run against the cover instead: p3 rows 129.00 = cover line 3 THIS 129.00 = CUMULATIVE 129.00; p2 zero rows = cover line 1 0/0/0.
gates.row_count: p3 rowbands.py: geometry_status ok, 37 h-rules / 36 bands, deskew 0.3 deg. Band 1 (8.99-11.77 pct) is the only band carrying ink (the filer wrote just below the header rule) -> 1 row emitted, matches. p2 rowbands not needed: page is visually empty at 170 dpi normalized.
gates.geometry_proof: p3 first row = last row (single row). Crop x=150..4350 y=580..830 @600dpi renders '3/15/12  Kinkos  Brochures'; amount crop x=4200..5200 y=580..830 renders '129.00'; control one row-pitch below (x=4300 y=830 W=900 H=170 @600dpi) renders EMPTY (only the ruled line).
gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 (balance at end) is written 0 / 129.00 / 129.00. The identity beginning + contributions - expenditures does NOT close: 0 + 0 - 129.00 = -129.00, but the filer wrote +129.00. This is the FILER's arithmetic (a sign error, or the filer read line 4 as 'total spent'); both figures retained verbatim, nothing recomputed. The internal cover identity LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE closes on every line (0+0=0, 0+0=0, 0+129.00=129.00, 0+129.00=129.00).

escalation_note: p3 amount cell at 600 dpi tight crop (confirmed 129.00, not 1.29 or 129.80); p3 full row band at 600 dpi (date/vendor/purpose); p1 cover lines 1-2 at 600 dpi (confirmed handwritten '0' ovals, not dashes); p1 cover lines 3-4 at 600 dpi (confirmed 129.00 in both THIS and CUMULATIVE on both lines).
